negatives.observed: The first Python report-source inspection stopped when the Windows cp1252 console could not encode the Māori macron.
negatives.recovery: Forced UTF-8 standard output and reran the same read to inspect the complete report source without changing it.
negatives.promotion_effect: The truncated inspection is retained and is not report-review evidence.

negatives.observed: A broad inherited acronym-expansion search exceeded its bounded timeout before returning a usable result.
negatives.recovery: Kept the established project labels unchanged and added contextual glossary descriptions without inventing unverified long forms.
negatives.promotion_effect: The timed-out search is retained and is not abbreviation-completeness evidence.

negatives.observed: The first semantic stale-label scan used an invalid PowerShell and rg quoting or wildcard combination, so its phase and owner value subchecks did not execute.
negatives.recovery: Retained the failed invocation and reran the review with explicit repository paths and literal fixed-string checks.
negatives.promotion_effect: The malformed scan is not stale-label review evidence; only the corrected bounded rerun is evidence.

negatives.observed: A Git checkout-index attempt did not convert the inherited CRLF legacy-alias fixture to its repository LF bytes, and the complete suite therefore returned 599 of 600 with the known warning-count mismatch.
negatives.recovery: Retained the failed 599-of-600 run, applied an explicit reversible newline-only conversion to the inherited fixture, reran the complete suite, and restored the original clean CRLF worktree bytes afterward.
negatives.promotion_effect: The 599-of-600 run is a failure and is not counted as repository-suite evidence.

negatives.observed: A semantic stale-label review traversed an unnecessarily broad recursive scope and timed out before producing a complete result.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout and reran fixed-string checks over only the current owner packet and the exact v644-v4 scripts and test module, excluding the inherited negative body where prior phase labels are expected evidence.
negatives.promotion_effect: The timed-out traversal is not stale-label review evidence.

negatives.observed: A bounded fixed-string JSON-label scan lost its literal quote characters through PowerShell argument parsing and then stopped on an owner-field no-match.
negatives.recovery: Retained the failed invocation and constructed the JSON field needles from the quote character before rerunning the bounded review with explicit no-match handling.
negatives.promotion_effect: The quote-stripped output is not semantic label-review evidence.

negatives.observed: A targeted fixed-string check showed that a JSON quote character constructed in a PowerShell variable was still removed by Windows native-command argument parsing, producing a no-match against a known phase field.
negatives.recovery: Retained the no-match and verified a PCRE hex-quote pattern against the same file before using that pattern for the bounded semantic review.
negatives.promotion_effect: The variable-constructed no-match is not semantic label-review evidence.

negatives.observed: The first post-evidence divergence display let PowerShell reinterpret the upstream revision token, so Git rejected the resulting invalid revision even though the separately captured local, upstream, tracking, and live heads were equal.
negatives.recovery: Retained the display failure and used separately quoted revision arguments for later divergence checks.
negatives.promotion_effect: The malformed divergence field is not 0/0 divergence evidence.

negatives.observed: A combined complete-suite help, attribute, and Git-configuration inspection exceeded its short timeout after returning only the help text.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout and used path-scoped detached-state and byte-hash checks with longer bounded windows.
negatives.promotion_effect: The partial help output is not checkout-configuration evidence.

negatives.observed: The first evidence-A worktree materialization exceeded its 120-second wrapper timeout before returning a receipt, although a later audit found the detached worktree fully registered at the exact evidence head.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout, audited the completed path directly, and used longer windows for later fresh snapshot materialization.
negatives.promotion_effect: The timed-out wrapper is not materialization evidence.

negatives.observed: A ten-second evidence-A hash, status, and head audit timed out without returning its receipt.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout and reran the same path-scoped audit with a longer bounded window.
negatives.promotion_effect: The short timed-out audit is not detached-state evidence.

negatives.observed: The first evidence-A complete suite used an all-LF checkout and failed 599 of 600 because an inherited v641 equation-lineage fixture was generated from the normal Windows checkout byte form.
negatives.recovery: Retained the failed clean snapshot and created fresh hybrid snapshots using the normal checkout byte form with only the exact legacy-alias fixture normalized to repository LF bytes.
negatives.promotion_effect: The 599-of-600 snapshot is failed evidence and does not count toward repeatability.

negatives.observed: The first hybrid snapshot retry wrapper used PowerShell backticks inside a JavaScript template literal and failed before invoking the shell.
negatives.recovery: Retained the wrapper failure, confirmed the target path remained absent, and resubmitted the same operation through a plain string wrapper.
negatives.promotion_effect: The syntax failure created no snapshot and is not validation evidence.

negatives.observed: The first read-only lifecycle-template lookup mixed PowerShell array syntax into the JavaScript wrapper and failed before reading any file.
negatives.recovery: Retained the wrapper failure and reran the bounded reference read through a plain PowerShell command.
negatives.promotion_effect: The syntax failure is not lifecycle-template review evidence.

negatives.observed: The post-closeout four-way equality wrapper received a valid tab-delimited 0/0 divergence result but compared it with a space-delimited literal and exited after already proving all four heads equal.
negatives.recovery: Retained the wrapper exit and normalized divergence output as two numeric fields in subsequent equality checks.
negatives.promotion_effect: The failed string comparison is not the terminal 0/0 divergence receipt.
